title: Using machine learning to predict deterioration of symptoms in COPD patients within a telemonitoring program.
summary: Full PMC article reports CatBoost and neural models predicting COPD deterioration within three days from telemonitoring histories, with temporal holdout and a prospective real-world validation dataset.
ai_technology: CatBoost and neural networks learn from patient-submitted telemonitoring history and engineered temporal features.
organization: Respiratory Department; BioCruces-Bizkaia Health Research Institute

evidence.tested: Full PMC article reports CatBoost and neural models predicting COPD deterioration within three days from telemonitoring histories, with temporal holdout and a prospective real-world validation dataset.
evidence.unknown: Temporal train/validation/test split plus 14,253-sample prospective dataset; AUROC/AUPRC and feature analyses reported.
evidence.ai_role: CatBoost and neural networks learn from patient-submitted telemonitoring history and engineered temporal features.
